title: Kagamine Len — Arms Laden With Snacks〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: DJ me and idol me both seem to be doing well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That just leaves band me, show me...and also...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I wonder how he's been. He was able to get back safely, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna go see how he's doing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hmm, is he taking a look at the tree?
He's got a pretty serious look on his face...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wonder what's going on. I can't exactly ask him, though.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, perfect...!
Maybe they'll ask what he was doing.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You've been over here a lot lately, Len. What were you doing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Umm...
I was watering the tree, and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why were you looking at the tree?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: B-Because it'd be terrible if all of you ended up getting sent to different SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you keeping an eye on it just in case something weird happens again?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: He was pretty scared after he got sent over to a different SEKAI all alone.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So he's keeping an eye on the tree so no one else has to go through the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks for doing this for us, Len.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm super interested in visiting another SEKAI! Aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's not like I'm not interested, but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Just to be sure, people being sent to a different SEKAI doesn't usually happen, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't think it does, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I get why they're worried.
Their Len got sent away just a little bit ago.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, so, why don't we try doing whatever Len was doing when he got sent away?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You were watering the tree and patting the trunk and stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There, there. Grow big and strong...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's okay, Len, Miku. Mizuki's just messing with you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Sorry for scaring you guys like that.
But I'm totally fine! Just take a look!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So you see, Len, there's no—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Are the branches shaking?
But why? There's no wind...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So much happened just now that even I'm a bit confused.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Maybe the tree got mad at you for screwing around.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! I was just trying to make Len feel better by showing him that nothing is gonna happen!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, instead of messing with us, you should've just said that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But that wouldn't have had as big an impact...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. Mizuki was just trying to make “me” feel better.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Still, what did happen just now?
There's no wind here, but the branches started shaking...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku did say that anything could happen here, so does that more stuff will happen moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whatever happens, I hope it's fun!
